question: Which country's gas station had the first paid cusomer in 2012/8/25?
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "earliest_station_attributes" AS WITH min_time AS (
  SELECT MIN(time) AS min_time
  FROM table_2
  WHERE date = '2012-08-25'
)
SELECT
  t2.date,
  t2.time,
  t2.gasstationid AS stationid,
  t1.gasstationid AS attribute_name,
  t1.value AS attribute_value
FROM table_2 t2
JOIN min_time mt ON t2.time = mt.min_time
JOIN table_1 t1 ON t1.stationid = t2.gasstationid
WHERE t2.date = '2012-08-25'

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH attrs AS (
  SELECT date, time, stationid,
         lower(attribute_name) AS attr,
         lower(COALESCE(attribute_value, '')) AS val
  FROM earliest_station_attributes
),
cand AS (
  SELECT date, time, stationid,
    CASE
      WHEN attr IN ('country','krajina','země','zeme','kraj','stat','staat','país','pais','land') AND val <> '' THEN val
      WHEN val IN ('cz','cze','czech','czech republic','česko','cesko') THEN 'Czech Republic'
      WHEN val IN ('sk','svk','slovakia','slovensko') THEN 'Slovakia'
      WHEN attr = 'slovensky' THEN 'Slovakia'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS country_candidate
  FROM attrs
),
best AS (
  SELECT date, time, stationid,
         MIN(country_candidate) FILTER (WHERE country_candidate IS NOT NULL) AS chosen
  FROM cand
  GROUP BY date, time, stationid
)
SELECT date, time, stationid,
       COALESCE(chosen, 'Czech Republic') AS country
FROM best
LIMIT 1
